 Florida voters Janelle Irwin Taylor and Susan MacManus join ‘Special Report’ to discuss the state's competitive U.S. Senate and gubernatorial races ahead of Election Day. 
 Florida voters Janelle Irwin Taylor and Susan MacManus discuss the U.S. Senate race between GOP nominee Sen. Ashley Moody and Democratic nominee Angie Nixon. They also discuss Florida's gubernatorial race and the key issues shaping voter sentiment ahead of Election Day.
